Update an internal or built-in object with admin privileges.

This command allows modifying built-in objects that are normally immutable.
Built-in objects are shareable/reusable but can only be modified through
this command with admin privileges.

The update data can be provided via:
  - --file: Path to a YAML file containing the updates
  - --data: Inline YAML data
  - --field: Update a single field (format: field=value, can be used multiple times)
  - --auto-status: Advance to the next lifecycle-valid status (trait-gated)

Flags:
    --auto-status
      Advance status to the next lifecycle-valid status for this object kind
    --data <string>
      Inline YAML data for updates
    --dry-run
      Show what would be updated without actually updating
    --field <stringArray> (default: [])
      Update a field (field=value). Parses as JSON when valid, else literal
      string. Repeatable.
    --file <string>
      Path to YAML file containing update data

  Update a built-in component type
  zqk internal update COMP-TYPE-001 --field title="Updated Title"
  Update from file
  zqk internal update COMP-TYPE-001 --file updates.yaml
  Update multiple fields
  zqk internal update COMP-TYPE-001 --field title="New Title" --field description="New Description"
  Dry-run to see what would be updated
  zqk internal update COMP-TYPE-001 --field title="New Title" --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk internal update <id> [flags]

Flags:
      --auto-status             Advance status to the next lifecycle-valid status for this object kind
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --data string             Inline YAML data for updates
      --dry-run                 Show what would be updated without actually updating
      --field stringArray       Update a field (field=value). Parses as JSON when valid, else literal string. Repeatable.
      --file string             Path to YAML file containing update data
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
